title: Custom crit
description: Allows users to modify the crit chance and damage amount
body:
short version:

This plugin allows crits to do extra damage and randomly happen.

By using this plugin you can make ciritical hits do a custom amount of damage when attacking a mod / player.

![Dmagage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bba515075ba67579b5f3177026ac01ff388ef9d.png)

You are also able to make it so critical hits randomly happen by configuring a custom percentage.
![CHANCE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa2a9434cc1abad23c92713c0000866b1448d380.png)
